what: After scrolling past 150px, the large logo tag hanging at top left shrinks to .8x around its corner over .5s cubic-bezier(.6,.01,.12,1), and when you return within 150px it grows back over .6s ease — it is not tied to scroll but a CSS transition that changes once when the line is crossed. It does not shrink in the phone version (min-width).

options.at: Scroll distance at which shrinking starts (px), default 150
options.min-width: Does not shrink in windows at or below this width (px), default 0 — original 835
options.--fx-dur / --fx-ease: Duration and curve when pulling, default .5s · cubic-bezier(.6,.01,.12,1)
options.--fx-back-dur / --fx-back-ease: Duration and curve when growing, default .6s · ease
